name: 004-custom-macros-temps
description: 20 x 20 x 6 mm block verifying start/layer/end G-code macro expansion and first-layer temp drop

machine.start_gcode:
;LC_START hot=[first_layer_temperature] bed=[first_layer_bed_temperature] layers=[total_layer_count]
G28
M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature]
M109 S[first_layer_temperature]

;LC_END max_z=[max_z] nozzle=[nozzle_temperature]
